newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index down on political jitters.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index down on political jitters.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse market index lost 0.51 points to 320.01 on Monday, reflecting an uncertain political climate in the country, brokers said.
Shares transacted totalled 133,034 for 2.62 million rupees, down from 8.09 million rupees on 211,937 shares last Friday.
Market observers blamed the current lacklustre performance of the Mauritius bourse to a lack of investor interest, derived from what they saw as an uncertain political climate.
Even if the economic fundamentals are good with a 5.8 percent growth forecast for this year, the market is affected by the uncertain political climate, one market analyst said.
"The lack of a finance minister is starting to become an increasing concern," he added.

Mauritian Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam promised to make a government cabinet reshuffle in early August, from which a new finance minister was expected to emerge. But he still has not given any date.

Deputy Premier Paul Berenger told reporters on Saturday: "It is my duty to say that I am worried on certain serious things on this absence of reshuffle. The country needs a (good) team to face certain frightening problems which already exist," he said.
Shares continued to trade within thin ranges as the market kept its wait and see attitude after Berenger's weekend comments, brokers said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 72 rupees on 11,958 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 8.50 rupees on 15,732 shares.
Consolidated Investment Trust gained 10 cents to 9.20 rupees on 11,382 shares and Fincorp Investment rose one rupee to 70 on 952 shares.
National Investment Trust was 10 cents higher to 11.70 rupees on 13,000 shares and United Docks was unchanged at 39.80 rupees on 11,273 shares.
Sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert was stable at 35 rupees on 8,850 shares. Conglomerates Rogers remained at 89 rupees on 1,350 shares while Ireland Blyth shed 20 cents to 12.50 rupees on 400 shares.

Commerce-based Courts was unchanged at 3.80 rupees on 24,500 shares. Hotel concern Sun Resorts fell by 30 cents to 35.70 rupees on 974 shares while New Mauritius Hotels was up 10 cents to 28 rupees on 1,413 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 50 rupees on 680 shares.
